question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Are you happy that Sam won the Spartan Games?
What do you think of Sam and Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I haven't had the chance to do a photo shoot since Spartan closed down...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But if I had my camera with me, this would be perfect.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What would?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The stars in the sky... The fire light... You...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... That's so sweet!
Nick and Sam part quickly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, sorry, guys! It's, uh, my turn to stand watch now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, okay. I guess I'll turn in for the night...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good night, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Good night.
Sam walks to her tent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wonder what would have happened... If $ZOE hadn't come up...
Sam has failed.
Try again and see if you can calm everyone down before they start shooting each other!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Any exes lurking in your background?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nope, no lurkers.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I haven't really dated anyone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Someone like you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I did attend an all boys' school for most of my life.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can see how it'd be hard to get a date.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I've had a date here and there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I wouldn't say I've really been too interested in anyone.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Mostly, I just threw myself into my work. I would say my first love is actually photography.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You told me earlier that you wanted to use the winnings from the Spartan Games to build a photography lab.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's right. One of the things I really miss about Spartan is their lab.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't know what I'd do if I couldn't develop my pictures properly...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you like about taking pictures?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like trying to capture a photo the way I had it in my head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And there's nothing more fun to me than waiting for everything to be `just so` to take that perfect shot.
nodes.text_bbcode: And there's nothing more fun to me than waiting for everything to be [color=#e23b3b][i]just so[/i][/color] to take that perfect shot.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You have to be pretty patient to be a photographer, and I have that in me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's like love... The lighting, the moment, and the timing have to be just right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never thought about it that way before...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like I said before... Sports references all the time.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sounds like it should've been a `slam dunk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like it should've been a [color=#e23b3b][i]slam dunk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No? I'll stop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In the end, Spencer and I had nothing in common.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He loves football, I like swimming. He loves action movies, I love scary movies.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can see how that didn't work out.
A silence stretches between them. Sam takes this moment to move closer to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what about you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hm? What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We had a thing a while back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A `long` while back. But it ended quickly.
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]long[/i][/color] while back. But it ended quickly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He was nice and sweet, and after my last boyfriend, he was just what I needed...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to go on about my past love life.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, it's fine. I think you need to talk about it. What went wrong?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I realized that it was taking us a lot of effort to stay together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: More effort than it should've.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And more effort than it ever had with my other ex.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I just figured it wasn't meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, he was just not someone I really got along with.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, really. He's strictly a friend. We are just friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's all we're ever going to be.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You must like him a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like him? ...Oh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, he's someone I've already dated and broken up with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The truth is... Things ended pretty quickly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He was just not someone I really got along with.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica and I definitely aren't friends.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact, I think we have a score to settle, don't we?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't even think about shooting me...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Too late!
Taylor shoots at Jessica, just as Jessica shoots back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not the paint!
The sound of paintballs makes everyone panic! Nick, Sam, and Ben all raise their guns and shoot one another!
When the chaos dies, everyone looks down at themselves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no... We're all covered in paint!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What... What have we done?!
There is a brief moment of silence...
Then Nick starts chuckling.
Before long, so does $ZOE, then Ben, then finally, Taylor and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sorry. I don't know what came over me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, these games are really getting to us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for defusing that situation, Sam.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just happy to still be in the running... It could have ended up so much worse...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I try not to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, now that we've settled that... How about we travel on a little further and make camp?
Sam blanks out and says nothing.
In that moment of silence, Jessica and Taylor come to one realization...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know, Jessica... I don't think I ever really told how much I hate the way you kicked me off the team...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I never told you how much I hated it when you were the Cheer Captain...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's a good thing I took your spot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stole it, more like!
Taylor shoots at Jessica, just as Jessica shoots back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Agh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not the paint!
The sound of paintballs makes everyone panic! Nick, Sam, and Ben all raise their guns and shoot one another!
When the chaos dies, everyone looks down at themselves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no... We're all covered in paint!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What... What have we done?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, now that that's settled... Do you guys have any snacks?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not much.
Erik makes a sad puppy face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, maybe you can have the candy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!
Taylor, Erik, and Ben fall on the candy with zeal.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what happened to the rest of the nerds?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a sad tale of woe and tragedy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik's right. We lost a lot of people in the last onslaught...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It was really an `onslaughter!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was really an [color=#e23b3b][i]onslaughter![/i][/color]

nodes.text: On the run from some Spartans, the nerds take a brief breather.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... They got Dex...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Not Dextrous Shadowguard, the man who could never trip in the dark!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We still have to move quickly. There are Spartans in this place... They could come from anywhere at any time...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, from behind, `right now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, from behind, [color=#e23b3b][i]right now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Take them out, Spartans!
A volley of paintballs comes at the nerds! Taylor, Ben, and Erik jump aside in time, but Brendan and Angie get stuck in the crossfire!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Don't mourn for us! Get out now! We'll hold them off!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But...!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on!
Ben and Erik grab Taylor's arms and drag her away...
Back in the present...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that's the last time I'll ever see him...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In this game.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Sorry, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So we vowed to make Spartan pay for what they did.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we're running out of ammo, food, and pretty much everything else.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We don't have enough paintballs to take out Chad and all his minions.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So what was your plan?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We heard some rumors... Rumors about an abandoned town in the middle of the estate.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: An abandoned town? Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's supposed to be a haven. There's ammo, more guns, snacks, and water.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We were heading there now when we saw this cabin. And you know the rest.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, I wonder if that's where we should be heading next.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't want to stay here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're in the same boat as you. This cabin might provide some protection, but there's nothing here for any of us.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I think this is a sign we should just move on.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe we should try to get to this abandoned town.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, we can't stay here forever, and if we can get there before any other Spartans, maybe it'll give us the firepower we need to take them out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then let's go!
After taking everything useful they can carry, the group departs.
At first, the day is long and hard...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My feet are starting to blister...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My `blisters` are starting to blister!
nodes.text_bbcode: My [color=#e23b3b][i]blisters[/i][/color] are starting to blister!

nodes.text: But it becomes easier with time and conversation...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then Spencer and I slipped through the halls and found Barry the Badger...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to know what happens when a badger meets an electric razor? Bzzzzz!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, I remember seeing that! That was great!
Until finally, in another section of the woods...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right guys. We need to be really careful. The last time we went through this, we ran into some Spartans.
Ben indicates some leftover paint on the trees and bushes in the area.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They could strike at any moment...
Suddenly, there's a sound in the brush!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Watch out, it could be...
Before Sam even has time to raise her gun, there's a paintball gun in her face!
Sam stares down the barrel of the gun into Jessica's hard, brown eyes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Neither of you move.
Without moving her head, Sam shifts her view and sees Jessica is pointing a second gun at Taylor who has a gun on Ben.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot me, and I take your boyfriend down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!
One more glance tells Sam that Nick is pointing his main gun at Jessica and his pistol at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, this got tense fast.
$ZOE and Amanda step around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, look! It's Sam and Ben! It's people we trust. We can put the guns away now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm doing no such thing. We don't know if they're actually on our side, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, we aren't if you keep waving that thing in my face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica, put your gun down, and Taylor will do the same.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No way, boyfriend. She'd shoot you and me in a heartbeat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, she wouldn't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes, I would.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, unless you stop pointing that thing at Sam, this is going to get colorful real fast.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh oh. Everyone's on a short fuse right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I don't say something... We're all going to take each other out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, if `I'm` the sane, rational one here, there's a `big` problem.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the sane, rational one here, there's a [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew it was too much power for Jessica to take two weapons at the last cache drop!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's it going to take for everyone to drop their weapons?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know, but I don't like the way you're looking at me, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd better be careful what I say next...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, guys. Seriously. Lower your guns...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's proven that he won't do anything to harm me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He hasn't proven himself to `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He hasn't proven himself to [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And what would I have to do to prove myself?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Stand on your head?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What? No! That proves nothing!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Except his agility!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just leave it, Taylor. He's a friend.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I like friends!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is there anyone you don't like?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't like people who are mean, punch others, and don't pay their taxes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awfully specific.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They go hand in hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: In either case, he's had many chances to take me out, and he hasn't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. But if you're wrong, I'm going to make sure you both pay when these stupid games are through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not only is he trustworthy, but he's useful. With his help, I think we can make it to the end.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We don't need help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't we? The Spartans got the drop on us at the beginning, didn't they?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They've taken most of us out and are hunting the rest down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Nick knows how the Spartan leaders think, and that's what we need if we're going to win.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, I don't know anything about what Chad, Carson, and Preston are up to, do you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh... No. I don't.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, what do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm sure most of the Spartans have been taken out. I think it might be time to leave the cabin.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know. It's hard to leave a place that's done us so much good.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But we still need to get rid of the remaining Spartans, and I have no idea what they're up to next.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We're sitting ducks if we just stay here.
There's a sudden crash from outside!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Someone ran into our traps!
Nick and Sam grab their paintball guns and rush to the front of the house. Sam cautiously looks out through a window.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who is it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's Centerscore...
Her paintball gun at the ready, Sam opens the door.
Ben, Taylor, and Erik are tangled on the ground in a heap of cans and string.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cans on string? You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sidelined by the oldest trick in the book...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I really rolled a one on stealth there, didn't I?
Sam raises her gun carefully and approaches them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you guys doing here?
The three trespassers look up at her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Sam... We could use a hand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how do I know you're not just going to shoot me as soon as you stand up?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'd never do that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, we're all on the same side... Aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are we?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes!
Sam hesitates, then reaches down and helps untangle them all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How did you get even strung up like this?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We were really excited...
They all get to their feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We thought the cabin would be a good place to rest and get supplies.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Especially snacks! Do you have any?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come with me.
Sam brings them into the cabin. When Taylor sees Nick, she draws her gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, don't shoot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But he's Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. But we've been working together.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Working together? But how can that be? Spartan and Centerscore are like one-armed giants and gross goblins, worms and birds... Mortal enemies!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Erik, it's not as dramatic as that... And Nick initiated the ceasefire. He rescued me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what? Why haven't you gotten rid of him?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He's still on the other side! You're better off without him! I say we shoot him now!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm standing right here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to shoot him because...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We do? How do you figure that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, we don't have any more?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We only have what's in our guns... Which isn't much at all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, the things really are looking kind of grim.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha, how could I forget?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who needs supplies when you have a partner as good as I am?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, buddy... It seems to me that `you're` the lucky one here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, buddy... It seems to me that [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] the lucky one here.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, then maybe we're just good partners for each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: All right. You've lifted my spirits.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam. Maybe there is a way to win this after all.
Sam stops, unsure of what to say.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's okay. You don't have to say anything. I get how bad the situation is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I wanted to say something comforting, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not really good at that sort of thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe we'll figure something out?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam.
$ZOE runs like the wind, dust billowing behind her as she takes off!
A couple of the Spartans chasing her take shots, but she manages to dodge and weave around them.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm almost there! It's so close...
With a final burst of speed, $ZOE runs behind the shooting gallery.
And there, behind a large picture of a fuzzy yellow duck, she finds...
Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! I've been so worried!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And `I've` been just sick thinking about you all alone out here!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]I've[/i][/color] been just sick thinking about you all alone out here!

nodes.text: They embrace, feeling safe and secure in one another's arms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But how did you end up here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you might be near the water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where the ducks are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So after the ambush, I followed the river, but I just couldn't find you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know what you mean...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I kept going. Eventually, the river led me to a stream where I saw the ducks from the shooting gallery!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I came just as everyone was getting shot at! I didn't think ducking in here would lead me to you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even if we're together... I don't know how we're going to make it out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we came together. We're going to leave together.
Howard gestures with his gun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go out, guns blazing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too.
They kiss...
And then jump out from behind the gallery, their weapons out and ready.
Backs to one another, they start firing in different directions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Arrrrrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Arrrrrr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Take that!
Several Spartan underlings go down before the return fire takes $ZOE and Howard out!
As they leave the ghost town...
$ZOE takes Howard's hand.

Try again and see if you can reach the shooting gallery!

then.text: And finally, Sam jerks her gun to Chad...

Try again and see if you can mix everything right this time!

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: $ZOE sprints down towards the shooting gallery.
She spares one glance back at her pursuers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're so close!
Suddenly, her leg clips a watering trough, and she tumbles in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhhh!
`Splash!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Splash![/b]

nodes.text: $ZOE lands in the trough!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cough... Cough... That water is gross!
As she spits up water, the Spartan boys surround her.
$ZOE looks forlornly at the shooting gallery and spies the yellow ducks in a row...
And that's the last thing she sees before her world goes yellow.
Both girls fire at the same time, pegging each other with paint!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ow! That stings!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ow! My arm!
Next to them, Amanda points a gun at her own foot and shoots!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So pretty!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What did you do `that` for?
nodes.text_bbcode: What did you do [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] for?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I thought that it was the game we were playing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh... Amanda...
The girls walk off the field together.
While the other cheerleaders take care of their own matters, $ZOE runs desperately away from the square down one lane of the town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where to go!
Suddenly, $ZOE can hear the far off noise of ducks quacking in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What on earth?
$ZOE follows the sound around a building. Down the street she's on, she can make out a practice shooting gallery.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The duck noises are from the plastic ducks you shoot at!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This must be a sign...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey! I see one of them! Near the gallery!
$ZOE looks to the porch where Chad and Carson are directing teams of Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: After her!
She hears the thundering of feet and knows the Spartans are almost on her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time to run!
She hurtles down the lane towards the shooting gallery!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And this is going to be `so` sweet...
nodes.text_bbcode: And this is going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sweet...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can't predict everything, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Which means it's only a matter of time before you fall to the bottom.
Ben hesitates a second too long!
The mistake costs him dearly...
Before Ben knows it, he's surrounded on all sides by Spartans and trapped behind the counter!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Have any last words, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Please don't?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Fire!
Ben is bombarded by paintballs!
While Ben deals with the Spartans, Jessica sprints around a building and through a garden area.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't believe we're trapped here! I'm too close to victory to leave the game now!
Jessica runs around a path in the garden and stops short.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, Jessica.
In front of her stand Taylor and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `You.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just want everyone to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what I want.
Taylor draws her gun and points it at Jessica at the same time Jessica points hers at Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why are you doing this?
Ben makes a grab for the white bottle, but his hand finds empty space!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used that one already!
The mistake costs him greatly.
The splatter of a paintball on the other side of the counter makes Ben jump but doesn't stop him from dumping the contents of the yellow bottle in!
Immediately, the chemicals start to make a fizzing sound as they mix together.
By the time the Spartans have surrounded Ben on all sides, trapping him between the counter and the wall, he's ready.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Have any last words, Ben Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I do...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Eat paint!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Eat paint![/i][/color]

nodes.text: At that moment, there's a small explosion as the concoction that Ben's mixed explodes, sending projectile globs of paint at everyone around him!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: `Noooo!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooo!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: When the paint settles, Preston glares angrily at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: What'd you go and do that for? Now none of us are going to win!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah well, I gave my other friends better odds of winning now that you and your team have been taken out.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You're relying on them to win it for you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We practically have this in the bag.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope...
Ben grabs the yellow bottle and dumps it in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, it should've been the green one!
Ben stares down at his concoction and thinks about how he can fix it...
But it's too late.
Ben dumps the contents of the green bottle in!
He can hear the heavy thud of feet approach the counter.
Ben quickly grabs the...
Ben dumps the contents of the white bottle in!
When the old swinging doors to the general store burst open, Ben quickly makes a grab for the...
Ben grabs the yellow bottle and dumps it in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, that's the wrong one!
Ben stares down at his concoction and thinks about how he can fix it...
But it's too late.
After a relatively peaceful night, the group sets out the next day, trudging across the estate until at last...
The group finds itself before the large ranch-like gates of an Old Western-style town.
Rustic wooden buildings line a wide, dusty street.
Bales of hay, hitching posts, and empty water troughs for horses are strewn about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is this for real?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This wasn't here last year.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When they said it was a 'ghost town', I thought they just meant it was empty.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it's like we're in a movie about the Old West! There's an old stagecoach!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's even a 'general store', a 'saloon', and a 'bank'!
Erik points to the central square of the town.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Look, guys, over there!
In the center of the square is a huge cache of weapons, snacks, and other supplies.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet that has all the supplies we need.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We could live here forever!
Erik rushes towards the center square.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Erik! What did I say about running ahead?!
As soon as Erik's feet hit the edge of the square, he's hit with several paintballs all at once!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik!
Erik hits the ground, gasping weakly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll... I'll see you on the other side...
Suddenly, all around them, Spartans spring up on the rooftops of all the buildings!
At the end of the street, Chad, Preston, Carson, and Lee pop up from atop the bank.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Nice of you to drop by...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But this is the end of the line for you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You mean this was all a trap?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Yep! And you fell right into it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We lured everyone here with false rumors of all this bounty.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We knew people would get desperate enough to come.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And here you are.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Since you're the only `Centerpoor` losers left, once we're done with you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Since you're the only [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerpoor[/i][/color] losers left, once we're done with you...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: The school, as you know it, will be finished!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! That means... That means Howard is...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ready, men!
All the Spartans raise their guns.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Aim...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! This can't be happening...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This can't be the end of the line!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I should have known they'd do something so cheap.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe we fell into it...
Before Chad can say the final word...
The sound of galloping horses fills the air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does... Does anyone else hear that?
Spartans and Centerscore students look around in confusion.
A short ways away, two lone riders gallop in on horseback.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Tom?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You two!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Us two! We're here to take you down!
Colt rides forward into the fray, firing two guns at all the shooters on the roofs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where'd you even get horses?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They were just sitting in a pen somewhere in the middle.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And we stole them like commoners!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Commoners aren't always thieves, Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I hate to inform you that...
His words are cut short by a paintball to his chest!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! Not this sweater!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Clear out of the way, silvershoes. I'm charging!
Colt rides in a circle around the square, taking on the Spartans on the rooftops!
His movement causes a massive duststorm to rise around the Centerscore students, shielding them for a few precious moments.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Someone, get them!
Carson brings up his gun.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Time to paint ourselves a Ghost.
He shoots, and the aim is true!
Just after Colt takes out another round of Spartans, he goes down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni... At last, we can be together...
Meanwhile, Ben rallies the rest of the group.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is our chance to take cover, guys! Scatter!
The Centerscore group disbands!
Ben rushes from the square and stumbles into the building marked 'General Store'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got to hide!
He jumps over the cash register counter and sags against a shelf where supplies sit.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Safe!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But for how long?
He peeks over the counter. Through the window, he can see Preston and seven more Spartans approaching the door.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I think I saw him come in here, guys! Let's root him out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Ben checks his gun. Only a handful of paintballs are left.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can probably take down three or four Spartans at most...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that's only if I aim `right`... Which isn't a guarantee...
nodes.text_bbcode: And that's only if I aim [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color]... Which isn't a guarantee...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, if I'm going down, I'm taking everyone down with me!
Ben looks around... The shelf he's resting on has several different-colored bottles of unknown liquids under the sign 'Apothecary'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Chemicals!
Ben starts opening each bottle and checking each solution until a plan has formed in his head.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I have just enough stuff here to make my idea work!
With an old knife, he opens each of his paintballs and dumps the paint into an empty balloon-like sack.
Ben sets the bottles out in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I want to make it super explosive, then I need to mix some chemicals with the paint...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I have to mix these in a very specific order.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The red bottle has to go in first, then the `white` bottle...
nodes.text_bbcode: The red bottle has to go in first, then the [color=#e23b3b][i]white[/i][/color] bottle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then the `green` bottle and finally, the `yellow` bottle...
nodes.text_bbcode: Then the [color=#e23b3b][i]green[/i][/color] bottle and finally, the [color=#e23b3b][i]yellow[/i][/color] bottle...

nodes.text: Outside, Ben can hear the Spartans approaching.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I hope you're ready to go down, Ben! I know you're in here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need to do this quickly!
Ben dumps the red bottle in the sack and reaches for the...

nodes.text: As they walk off, Sam turns to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, we really pulled it off!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I admit... I had my doubts when you presented the plan to me.
A couple minutes earlier...
Nick and Sam duck behind a mountain of guns.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Where should we run?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to run anymore. I'm tired of these Games, and I'm sick of Chad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to take all of them out in one swoop.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How do you want to do that? I shot some of the Spartans before they could retreat.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't have any bullets left in my paintball gun...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I only have four shots in mine... Is there any ammo in this mountain of guns?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this was just a big trap. I checked a couple, but they're empty.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then we'd better make these paintballs count. How do you think we can get close?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, maybe we can use this whole Spartan-Centerscore rivalry thing to our advantage...
Present time...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But it all seemed to have worked out.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice shooting there, partner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I couldn't have done it without your superb acting skills...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Then it was a team effort.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look what Centerscore and Spartan can do when they actually work `together.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look what Centerscore and Spartan can do when they actually work [color=#3b78e2][i]together.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah really. We did it. We made it to the end.
They smile at one another...
For a moment, time stands still...
Then they step together in a kiss!
Nick winds his arms around Sam, and she pulls him closer!
The two kiss for an endless moment... Then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... We...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Kissed in front of the entire school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really `did` betray my school...
nodes.text_bbcode: I really [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] betray my school...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did you?
The sound of a paintball breaks the silence.
Nick looks down at his black shirt where a yellow pellet has burst open from Sam's paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not.
For a moment, Nick doesn't say anything... Then a grin spreads across his face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You cheater, you took my plan!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess it had to be one of us...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean, `at least` it was one of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] it was one of us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Spartan, let's go home.
Wow, Centerscore won the Spartan Games! All thanks to you!
But what's going to happen with the rest of the money?
Find out next week!
And don't forget to purchase a `Story Vote Ticket` in the On Demand Store!
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to purchase a [b]Story Vote Ticket[/b] in the On Demand Store!

nodes.text: Play through four sneak peeks, and then vote on which genre you want to play!
But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In two weeks, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But whatever you do... [b]Don't wait![/b] In two weeks, the two genres with the fewest votes [b]will be eliminated...[/b]

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
The group keeps moving until finally...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can we stop now? It seems like everyone's a little beat...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not me! Nature invigorates me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I could leap the Himalayan mountaintops... Run the African plains... Graze like a gazelle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Erik. You do that. The rest of us will sleep.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awww...
The group sets up camp, building a small fire and pitching tents taken from the cabin.
Right before everyone turns in, Ben calls them to the center.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think it's a good idea to sleep without a lookout.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who wants to take the first shift?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Erik, when you're not falling asleep, you're falling into traps! No way are you on shift.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I can't. I'm so tired... Yawn... I promise to take the next shift though.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll do it. I'm not tired anyway.
As everyone settles down to sleep, Sam sits alone by the fire and keeps an eye out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never liked forest sounds...
Above the comforting sound of the fire crackling, Sam can hear the haunting noise of owls hooting and twigs snapping in the distant dark.
She draws her gun close.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It is a little lonely out here...
Sam hears footsteps behind her. She turns and finds Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you mind if I join you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wouldn't mind some company.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Otherwise, I'd just sit here thinking about all those crappy Spartans in the woods that are out to get us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, no offense.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: None taken. Although I hope you don't hold the fact I'm a Spartan against me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... It's kind of nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, to realize that our schools don't always have to be fighting. That we can actually get along.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course, I wish more Spartans were like you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know some of the guys can be intense, but we're not all bad. We're just... Adjusting. All we've ever known is Spartan.
Nick takes a seat on the log next to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So why aren't you sleeping?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't like forest sounds. Same as you, I'm guessing.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I saw you jump when the owl hooted.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They're weird, all right?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not arguing with that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So, how's your elbow?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's still there.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Glad to see it's hanging on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It certainly feels a lot better. Thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Any guy would have done the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't know the guys I know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They'd probably try to help, but they wouldn't know the safe end of a bandage if it hit them in the face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Is there a dangerous end of a bandage?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They wouldn't have picked up on that either.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not extremely perceptive then.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you're the first guy I've talked to in a while who hasn't brought up a funny sports joke or made a terrible sports reference.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Clearly I haven't been making the `right calls.` I need to `get my head in the game` if I'm `going to go for the gold.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Clearly I haven't been making the [color=#e23b3b][i]right calls.[/i][/color] I need to [color=#e23b3b][i]get my head in the game[/i][/color] if I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]going to go for the gold.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Groan... Don't even start. I've had enough of it from Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Who's Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Big guy. On the football team. He's...

nodes.text: I can't believe we're trapped here! I'm too close to victory to leave the game now!
Jessica runs around a path in the garden and stops short.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, Jessica.
In front of her stand Taylor and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `You.`

nodes.text: I just want everyone to be happy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what I want.
Taylor draws her gun and points it at Jessica at the same time Jessica points hers at Taylor!

nodes.text: Why are you doing this?

nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew it was too much power for Jessica to take two weapons at the last cache drop!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's it going to take for everyone to drop their weapons?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know, but I don't like the way you're looking at me, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd better be careful what I say next...

nodes.text: Come on, guys. Seriously. Lower your guns...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah really. We did it. We made it to the end.
They smile at one another...
For a moment, time stands still...
Then they step together in a kiss!
Nick winds his arms around Sam, and she pulls him closer!
The two kiss for an endless moment... Then pull away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... We...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Kissed in front of the entire school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really `did` betray my school...
nodes.text_bbcode: I really [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] betray my school...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Did you?
The sound of a paintball breaks the silence.
Nick looks down at his black shirt where a yellow pellet has burst open from Sam's paintball gun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe not.
For a moment, Nick doesn't say anything... Then a grin spreads across his face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You cheater, you took my plan!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I guess it had to be one of us...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You mean, `at least` it was one of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]at least[/i][/color] it was one of us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Spartan, let's go home.
Wow, Centerscore won the Spartan Games! All thanks to you!
But what's going to happen with the rest of the money?
Find out next week!

args.text: Sam tries to shoot, but her left hand slips on the gun!
By the time, she picks it up again, the Spartan boys have drawn their weapons.
It's about to get even worse.
The Spartans unleash a barrage of paintballs! Sam and Nick try to protect themselves from the onslaught, but they're hit!
Oh no! We're out of the game!
And you know what that means?
The next week, all of Centerscore watches in disgust as the money won in the Spartan Games gets lavished on the Spartans.
In the school hallway, personal butlers attend to each Spartan boy.
Why yes, Butler Alfred, I would like you to take my place in math class.
And don't forget to jot the homework down for you to finish later!
In the cafeteria, personal wait staff set down steaming plates of expensive food for them.
Is that steak and lobster with caviar for me? Why thank you!
I will eat them with my gold forks and knives now...
And outside, helicopters wait patiently to take the Spartan boys home.
It's awesome being rich! Spartan is the best! Spartan is the best!
Meanwhile, all the Centerscore students huddle together in the one classroom that the Spartans have left for them.
This sucks! They built their private swimming pools and their stretch limo parking lots all over our school!
At least they let us have something...
Yeah, this crappy classroom with no air conditioning, a leaky ceiling, and lights that don't work!
Ugh, Sam, this is all your fault! If you hadn't messed it all up...
Leave her alone! We all got shot.
No, Taylor's right. I shouldn't have crumbled under the pressure. I shouldn't have let you all down...
If only there were some way I could do it all again...
Try again and see if you can nail these Spartan creeps! They really deserve it!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.
What do you want to do?
The dust has settled. Most of the players are gone.
Nick and Sam stand alone in the town square...
And a few remaining Spartans stand on the other end!
I'm sorry I have to do this, Sam, but...
Nick holds up his gun and trains it on her.
Nick! What are you doing? I thought we had a truce!
Sorry, Samantha, but whatever you thought we had... It's over.
I... I don't know what to say.
Sam's hand goes for her back pocket.
Don't even bother going for your gun. It's out of ammo.
I unloaded it while you were sleeping. See, I've been waiting for this moment.
Wait, so what you're telling me is that you've conned me this entire time?!
Yeah. Now you're coming with me.
Nick prods her forward with the paintball gun, and he makes her march down the long lane to the porch where Chad, Carson, and Lee are standing.
I'd advise you not to come any closer. Or we'll shoot. You know we're good for it.
I wouldn't advise that. I'm on your side.
I say we shoot him anyway.
Hey, before you start painting away, check this out.
I brought something just for you.
If you're really on our side, why don't you shoot her yourself?
Because I know she's been giving you some trouble, and I thought I'd give you the honor.
What do you say? Shoot the last Centerscore student and end these games once and for all?
You're a jerk! You're the jerkiest jerk I know!
Thank you, Nick... We'll be glad to get rid of her. Lee, why don't you take this one?
Whatever makes these games go faster...
Lee's hand goes to his gun...
And that's when Sam pulls her own gun on him!
That doesn't scare us. It's empty. I heard Nick say so.
Well, the funny thing about that is...
Sam points her gun at Lee...
Aw, this will take forever to wash out of my leather jacket!
Sam jerks her gun to Carson...
And finally, Sam jerks her gun to Chad...
And with one final jerk, Sam shoots Chad!
For Centerscore! And for everyone you've humiliated and hunted down.
Careful, Chad... When I win the Spartan Games, I have a feeling you're the one who's going to be regretting a lot of the things you've done.
Don't you get it, Chad? It's over for us. Forget about being the Spartans.
Yeah. We'll be lucky if we even see any of that money.
They walk off, leaving Chad behind.
Chad walks off the field, dejected and alone.

Welcome all to the closing ceremonies of the 77th Spartan Games.
We shall begin the proceedings by awarding the prizes.
First, I'd like to invite the winner of the 77th Spartan Games up to the stage...
Sam steps onstage to the applause of the Centerscore students and the broody silence of the Spartan crowd.
For your bravery, resilience, and courage in the games, our Spartan sponsors are proud to award you the Spartan Crown!
I'm finally going to get a crown!
Here it is! The stunning Spartan Helm!
Shapiro has a couple students bring out a stunning, golden helmet with a rich red plume!
It's the Spartan's traditional crown. It represents the true warrior, their mascot.
But I thought... That isn't a...
Yes, it is now yours to wear as you like.
Sam takes the helmet and looks it over.
Well, I guess it wouldn't really be my crown unless it was also a symbol of war.
Sam holds it up, and Centerscore cheers!
And of course we can't forget about the cash prize of $100,000!
Shapiro produces a huge check for Sam to hold.
As stipulated, this money is set aside for school repairs and improvements.
But how to spend the money is entirely up to you.
I hope I don't have to remind you that the teachers have always wanted another cushy chair in the lounge...
From the crowd, the Centerscore students start calling out to Sam.
Use it for the swim team!
Use it on a date! With me!
Sam shakes her head and smiles.
She's going to use it `all` for Centerscore?
Uh-oh! The Spartan Games may be over, but it looks like there's going to be more fighting on the horizon...
Just what will Sam do with the $100,000?
Find out next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay, I got up for popcorn. Did anyone else get painted while I was gone?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ugh, who knows? All I can see on my screen are $ZOE, Amanda, and Jessica. And they keep arguing about boots...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll tell you who got painted! Jacob, Phil, and Zach!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, there goes some of the eye candy. This just got more boring.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, what you should be focusing on is that they were killed by Sam, that traitor!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, anyone can see `why.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, anyone can see [color=#3b78e2][i]why.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, they were threatening her and Nick.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't get me started on Nick. The point is...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's three less Centerscore students with a chance to win!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And there's only so many people left...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Most of the cheerleaders, the rebels, and the nerds were taken out.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't forget about the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right right... There are only a handful of Centerscore students still in there. And you know who `else` is still around?
nodes.text_bbcode: Right right... There are only a handful of Centerscore students still in there. And you know who [color=#e23b3b][i]else[/i][/color] is still around?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Chad.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Chad.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, in a cabin on Carson's vast family estate...
Sam and Nick sit on the couch, examining their options.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Looks like our time here is coming to an end.
Nick gestures to their rations: a sack of candy, a bag of pretzels, and an unopened can of beans.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: There's a couple bottles of water left as well.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'd think a house like this would have more supplies.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah well, they probably understocked it on purpose. It gets boring when people stay in the same place the entire time.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But I'm not going to lie... We don't have much left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least we have...
